label: common_0095_mama_02
text: I hear that Nemona here will be taking you\nto school?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_rival_01
text: That’s right, ma’am. Leave it to me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0095_mama_03
text: So you’ve already managed to make a friend![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_04
text:
And I read about all the wonderful teachers
you’ll have looking after you at the school.\c
Plus so many handy facilities you can use as much
as you like![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_05
text: Add in your new friend, Nemona, and it sounds\nlike your school life is shaping up to be fantastic![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_09
text: Now, you’ll be staying in the school dorms, so I\nwant you to promise me you’ll eat proper meals.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_06
text: Here’s a bit of spending money to start off with.\nI also packed a lunch for your first day![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_10
text: Oh! And maybe you’d better take these, too.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_11
text: Use them on that precious little partner of yours,\nshould it get hurt in battle.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_12
text: I know every day in your new life is going to be\nfull of exciting experiences, far from home.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_13
text: Just try to savor them all—the good times and\nthe hard times, too![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_07
text: But if you ever want to come back home, you\nknow your bed is always ready for you.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_mama_08
text: Oh, all right then! You two had better be off,\nI suppose. Take care on the way to school![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0095_rival_03
text: Oh! But I was going to teach you how to catch\nwild Pokémon! C’mon, vamos![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
